items.title: Exactly 4 Litres 💧 Riddle #10 Answer + Riddle #11: 8 Balls, 1 Heavy, 2 Weighings ⚖️ #shorts

qa.heard: Yesterday, 2 jugs, 3 liters and 5 liters. How do you get exactly 4?  Fill the big jug, then pour it into the small jug. 2 liters stay in the big jug.  Now empty the small jug and pour those 2 liters into it.  Fill the big jug again and top up the small jug. Only 1 more liter fits.  Exactly 4 liters are left in the big jug. Now, a brand new mystery.  Person 1 has 8 balls. They all look exactly the same.  But 1 ball is a little bit heavier than all the others.  Person 1 has a balanced scale and can use it only 2 times.  How can person 1 find the heavy ball for sure?  Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow at sunrise.

items.title: Peer Ka Din Itna Khaas Kyun? | Sahih Muslim 1162 #shorts

qa.heard: آج پیر کا دن ہے کہ آپ جانتے ہیں یہ دن اتنا خاص کیوں ہے؟  ہمارے نبی محمد مصطفہ صل اللہ تعالی علیہ وعایلی ہی وسلم  پیر کے روزے کے بارے میں پوچھا گیا تو فرمایا  یہ وہ دن ہے جس دن میرے والادت ہوئی اور جس دن مجھ پر وہی اتری  یعنی اپنی والادت کے دن کو آپ نے روزے اور شکر سے یاد کیا  آج روزہ رکھ سکیں تو رکھیں اور کسرت سے دورود شریف پڑھی  کمٹ میں دورود شریف لکھیں یہ ویڈیو آگا بھیجیں یہ بھی ایک اور صدقہ ہے

items.label: kids
items.title: Share With Your Friend! 🍪 Want for Others What You Want | Islam for Kids #shorts

qa.heard: Imagine you get a big yummy cookie. What would you want for your best friend?  Our Prophet Muhammad Mustafa,  sallallahu ta'ala alaihi wa a'ala alihi wa sallam  Once said, none of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.  So, if you love a yummy cookie, share some with your friend too.  If you love being picked to play, pick your friend too.  And if you love kind words, say kind words to your friend.  So always want for others what you want for yourself.  What will you share with a friend today?
